title: Towards AI-Assisted Research Writing: Benchmarking LLMs for AI/ML Introduction Generation
abstract: arXiv:2508.14273v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As researchers increasingly adopt LLMs as writing assistants, generating high-quality research paper introductions remains both challenging and essential. We introduce Scientific Introduction Generation (SciIG), a task that evaluates LLMs' ability to produce coherent introductions from titles, abstracts, and related works. Curating new datasets from NAACL 2025 and ICLR 2025 papers, we assess five state-of-the-art models, including both open-source (DeepSeek-v3, Gemma-3-12B, LLaMA 4-Maverick, MistralAI Small 3.1) and closed-source GPT-4o systems, across multiple dimensions: lexical overlap, semantic similarity, content coverage, faithfulness, consistency, citation correctness, and narrative quality. Our comprehensive framework combines automated metrics with LLM-as-a-judge evaluations. translated_title: 迈向AI辅助研究写作：面向AI/ML引言生成的大语言模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 随着研究人员越来越多地采用大语言模型作为写作助手，生成高质量的研究论文引言既具有挑战性又至关重要。我们提出了科学引言生成任务，该任务评估大语言模型根据标题、摘要和相关工作生成连贯引言的能力。通过从NAACL 2025和ICLR 2025论文中整理新数据集，我们从多个维度评估了五个最先进的模型，包括开源模型（DeepSeek-v3、Gemma-3-12B、LLaMA 4-Maverick、MistralAI Small 3.1）和闭源的GPT-4o系统，评估维度涵盖：词汇重叠、语义相似度、内容覆盖率、忠实度、一致性、引用正确性和叙事质量。我们的综合评估框架结合了自动化指标和大语言模型作为评审的评估方法。结果表明，LLaMA-4 Maverick在大多数指标上表现优异，尤其是在语义相似度和忠实度方面。此外，三样本提示方法……
tldr: 该研究提出了科学引言生成（SciIG）新任务及基于NAACL 2025和ICLR 2025论文的基准数据集，通过多维度评估框架发现LLaMA-4 Maverick在生成研究论文引言方面表现最佳。
en_tdlr: This study introduces the Scientific Introduction Generation (SciIG) task with new benchmark datasets from NAACL 2025 and ICLR 2025 papers, and finds through a multi-dimensional evaluation framework that LLaMA-4 Maverick achieves the best performance in generating research paper introductions.
